decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's established automation and formwork know-how, so strong absorptive capacity supports continued learning and refinement rather than discontinuation.
This automatic de-shuttering robot extends the firm's existing de-shuttering expertise, allowing the firm to assimilate early market feedback and improve the product.
The profile storage robot leverages the firm's in-house engineering and production control capabilities, giving it the relevant knowledge to interpret results and develop improvements.
The automatic shuttering robot builds on the firm's core shuttering and robotics competence, and its R&D experience enables the firm to absorb new information and enhance the product.

The combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine extends the firm's established material handling and automation offer, and the multiple models indicate active learning and improvement rather than withdrawal.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's existing controls and digital service capabilities, but data-analytics knowledge is less mature, so while the firm can assimilate and improve it, there is a moderate risk of discontinuation.
